conventions.authors: array of author names or institutional authors; do not invent missing authors
conventions.year: integer publication year or null when unresolved
conventions.doi: bare DOI string, or empty string for none/not verified
conventions.discovery_queries: array of actual query strings or search-log IDs
conventions.key_findings: original concise paraphrase; distinguish source result from reviewer inference
conventions.limits: Keep combined substantive summary per source compact, normally under 180 words; no long copied abstracts
conventions.unknown: Use explicit not reported/not checked/unknown rather than silently filling
